chunks: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yaqtin, from al-'Abd al-Salih عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about supererogatory prayer on Friday. He said: If you wish to perform supererogatory prayer on Friday while not traveling, then pray six rak'ahs at the rising of the day, six rak'ahs before midday, two rak'ahs when the sun declines before the Friday prayer, and six rak'ahs after the Friday prayer. And it has also been narrated that it is permissible for him to pray the same as he prays on the rest of the days.

key_terms.ارْتِفَاعَ النَّهَارِ: the early rise of the day after sunrise
key_terms.فِي غَيْرِ سَفَرٍ: while not traveling; in a non-travel state
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day of Jumu'ah prayer

ai.seo_question: How should supererogatory prayers be performed on Friday according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the recommended arrangement of supererogatory prayers on Friday for one who is not traveling. It details a preferred distribution of rak'ahs before and after Jumu'ah, while also noting a transmitted allowance to pray Friday nawafil in the same manner as on other days.
